name: a sibling worktree moves under the worktree root
a worktree under the root stays as it is
an absolute path under the root stays as it is
an option before the path does not hide the path
a quoted path with a space moves and keeps its last segment
a fetch before the worktree add stays in place
command: git fetch origin main && git worktree add ../ledger-12 -b feat/12-ledger origin/main
expected: git fetch origin main && git worktree add .claude/worktrees/ledger-12 -b feat/12-ledger origin/main

name: a separator without spaces still ends the statement
command: git fetch origin main&&git worktree add ../ledger-12 -b feat/12-ledger origin/main
expected: git fetch origin main&&git worktree add .claude/worktrees/ledger-12 -b feat/12-ledger origin/main

name: checkout -b in the main checkout becomes a worktree
switch -c with a start point keeps the start point
expected: git worktree add .claude/worktrees/ledger-7 -b fix/7-session origin/main && cd .claude/worktrees/ledger-7

name: switch to an existing branch becomes a worktree of that branch
a branch without an issue number gets a safe directory name
the rewrite stops at the end of the statement
expected: git worktree add .claude/worktrees/ledger-12 -b feat/12-ledger && cd .claude/worktrees/ledger-12 && pnpm install

name: a branch inside a worktree is left alone
a switch back to the default branch is left alone
a switch to the previous branch is left alone
a checkout of a file is not a branch
a pull request without --draft becomes a draft
a pull request with --draft stays as it is
a pull request with -d stays as it is
--draft goes into the gh statement and not after a later command
command: gh pr create --fill && gh pr view --web
expected: gh pr create --fill --draft && gh pr view --web

name: a --draft in a later command does not count
a redirection with an ampersand does not split the statement
a heredoc body is not changed
command:
gh pr create --title "Ledger" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
No draft here.
EOF
)"
expected:
gh pr create --title "Ledger" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
No draft here.
EOF
)" --draft

name: one command with every convention broken
command: git worktree add ../ledger-12 -b feat/12-ledger origin/main && gh pr create --fill
expected: git worktree add .claude/worktrees/ledger-12 -b feat/12-ledger origin/main && gh pr create --fill --draft

name: an unrelated command is left alone
a word that only contains git is not git
a quoted command substitution in a branch name is not rewritten
a quoted backtick in a branch name is not rewritten
a quoted command substitution in a worktree path is not rewritten
